This is not recorded as ROLLING because the page never says rolling or 'no fixed deadline' - it says the deadline is country-specific, which is a different statement - and it is not CONFLICTING because no two sources give different dates for the same deadline. NOTE on the shard's stored wording: 'U.S. Embassies/Fulbright Commissions must submit nominations by mid-September' does not appear anywhere on the official portal and no official source for it was found; it was not adopted. The page's country drop-down loads per-country detail via script that was not individually enumerated for every country, so per-country deadlines remain unexamined; a single country-specific date would not be a valid programme-level value for this record in any case.
